name: agentwatch
description: Windows Agent Notch desktop app watching Claude Code and Codex sessions

scripts.build:cli: npm run build:hook && npm run build:win32 && npm run build:sim
scripts.build:hook: go build -o resources/bin/agentwatch-hook ./cmd/agentwatch-hook && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o resources/bin/win-x64/agentwatch-hook.exe ./cmd/agentwatch-hook && GOOS=windows GOARCH=arm64 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o resources/bin/win-arm64/agentwatch-hook.exe ./cmd/agentwatch-hook
scripts.build:win32: GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o resources/bin/win-x64/agentwatch-win32.exe ./cmd/agentwatch-win32 && GOOS=windows GOARCH=arm64 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o resources/bin/win-arm64/agentwatch-win32.exe ./cmd/agentwatch-win32
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && npm run build:cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.sim.json
